item.description:
0.2.0

  • ⌘1–⌘9 goes straight to a tab — and ⌘/ lists every shortcut.
  • Recent connections on the connect window.
  • Saved credentials answer password prompts — the password goes from the Keychain to the session without being shown.
  • A saved credential could send the password of an account it no longer had. Fixed.
  • A sleeping display shrank the window and kept it that way. Fixed.

The app icon has a new colour — it will look different in your Dock.
